name: ghedirect-scraper
description: Node scraper for ghedirect.co.uk (Puppeteer + ProxyRack GB, Everton/Bueromarkt-style)

scripts.seed-sample: cp urls.sample.json urls.json && echo 'seeded home + product sitemap'
scripts.start-pp: USE_PROXY=1 HEADLESS=1 THREADS=1 BLOCK_TYPES= DELAY_MS=500 PP_TIMEOUT=45000 SERVER=http://127.0.0.1:5055 node puppeteer_worker.js
scripts.start-pp-visible: USE_PROXY=1 HEADLESS=0 HIDE_CHROME=0 THREADS=1 BLOCK_TYPES= DELAY_MS=500 PP_TIMEOUT=45000 SERVER=http://127.0.0.1:5055 node puppeteer_worker.js
